title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Digital and Technology (D\&T) India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2\+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10\+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5\-6 Years.
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non\-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams.
* Technical Skillset \- AI / Automation Activation, Adoption \& Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization.
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy.
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance .
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work .
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption.
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM\-enabled workflows is preferred.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to properly translate and articulate positioning and technology
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.


**Your Responsibilities:**

* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT

**The Essentials \- You Will Have:**

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience


Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)


Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals


Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed


Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent


Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;


Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.


Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done


Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.


Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.


Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition


Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams


Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.


Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).


Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development


Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing


You will report toTeam Lead \-IT


What We Offer:


Our benefits package includes …


* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

The Business \& Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting \& Innovation.  

  

Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology\-focused Product Leader to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be leading a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.  

  

This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases \& agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well\-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.  

Role  

* Define and own the AI product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Payment Performance Intelligence.
* Identify high\-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self\-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market trends, and business objectives into scalable product capabilities and clear technical requirements.
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Platform, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams to deliver AI products from discovery through launch.
* Drive prioritization decisions based on customer value, strategic fit, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and responsible AI considerations.
* Establish measurable success metrics and ensure product outcomes are repeatable, scalable, and aligned to business goals.
* Influence senior stakeholders, communicate roadmap progress, and build alignment on risks, opportunities, and investment decisions.
* Coach product teams and help build organizational capability in AI product management, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  

All About You  

* Extensive experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI\-enabled, or financial services products.
* Strong understanding of AI product strategy, GenAI use cases, data monetization, predictive insights, and self\-service analytics.
* Proven ability to convert customer problems and market opportunities into product vision, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance.
* Strong communication and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and articulate customer and business impact.
* People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and building high\-performing teams across diverse geographies.
* Highly organized, analytical, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or advanced product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Engineering Product Manager | 15+ Years
description:
Meet the Team
  
We are a small, agile, and highly collaborative unit within the provider mobility business unit, passionate about delivering strategic cloud native packet core, IoT, and SaaS solutions for some of the service providers and enterprises. title: Product Manager at Dolphin Studios
description:
A product manager defines, develops, and manages a product's entire lifecycle, bridging customer needs with business objectives to create a successful, viable product. Key responsibilities include defining product strategy and roadmaps, conducting market research to understand user needs, coordinating cross\-functional teams (engineering, marketing, sales), ensuring the product aligns with company goals, overseeing product launches, and tracking product performance post\-launch.
At Dolphin Studio LLC, we’re proud to offer innovative products that meet the needs of our customers. To help us continue expanding our offerings, we’re in search of an experienced product manager to lead a multidisciplinary development team. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for gaps in consumer product offerings and an innovative mindset for filling them. This person should be a highly skilled market analyst with a proven ability to strategize the full lifecycle of a product, from conception to release. We’re looking for a confident leader who can guide cross\-functional teams in the creation of products that improve customer experience and grow market share.
Objectives of this role
Drive the product\- and business\-planning processes for cross\-functional teams
Analyze customer needs, current market trends, and potential partnerships from an ROI and build\-vs.\-buy perspective
Assess current competitor offerings and seek opportunities for differentiation
Analyze product requirements and develop appropriate programs to ensure they’re met
Develop, implement, and maintain production timelines across multiple departments
Appraise new product ideas and strategize appropriate go\-to\-market plans
Responsibilities
Drive the execution of all processes in the product lifecycle, including product and market research, competitor analysis, planning, positioning, requirements and roadmap development, and product launch
Translate product strategy into detailed requirements for prototyping and final development by engineering teams
Create product strategy documents that describe business cases, high\-level use cases, technical requirements, revenue, and ROI
Analyze market data to develop sales strategies, and define product objectives for effective marketing communications
Collaborate closely with engineering, production, marketing, and sales teams in the development, QA, and release of products, and balance resources to ensure success for the entire organization
Develop product positioning and messaging that differentiates \[Company X] across primary market segments
Required skills and qualifications
Strong experience in a dynamic product management role
Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle
High effectiveness in managing cross\-functional teams
Experience in delivering finely tuned product marketing strategies
Exceptional writing and editing skills, combined with strong presentation and public speaking skills
Preferred skills and qualifications
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in product design or engineering
Previous experience in software and web development
Proven success as a product developer in a nonmanagerial role
Demonstrable knowledge of SEM (search engine marketing) and online advertising
